pages.title: Sugar for Guests
pages.text: Feeding birds connects gardening with pollination and new trees.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Feeders take water bottles and sugar. Give toucans tree fruits: fruit chooses the tree and golden apples accelerate planting. These are two useful bird cooperation routes.
